# Callouts: Flash backup 7.1 - the cooker's main board wired for the clip read

Source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~46 px/mm in this crop)  
Annotated image: [images/annotated/fb7-1_cooker-wiring.jpg](../../../images/annotated/fb7-1_cooker-wiring.jpg)

Supply through break-out A on J8. The reset hold from TP33 to GND at JP5 pin 2, on before power. The clip on U15 (pin 1 at the dots), five leads to the reader, no VCC lead. J14 position 3 as the optional SOP2 strap. The close-up is picture 7.2.
